description: A quote as a PDF (base64) in the shop's brand: logo, accent color, license number, lines, options and total. The date is in the shop's time zone (priv.shop_time_zone: the shop's own zone, otherwise its state's). The file is named Q-10.pdf from doc_no, or quote- plus the id when there is no number. An unsent draft's footer says Draft instead of Sent with Doing Work. Financing links use the signed total once the customer has signed, and the lowest option until then. The latest version unless version is given. Attach it to email or save it.
name: quotes_pdf
